action_schema.name: look
action_schema.description: Inspect the current location and nearby objects.

action_schema.name: inventory
action_schema.description: Inspect what the agent is currently carrying.

action_schema.name: open
action_schema.description: Open a closed openable receptacle at the current location.

action_schema.name: close
action_schema.description: Close an open receptacle at the current location.

action_schema.name: examine
action_schema.description: Examine a visible receptacle or object.

action_schema.name: take
action_schema.description: Take a visible object from a receptacle.

action_schema.name: put
action_schema.description: Put the carried object in or on a receptacle.

action_schema.name: clean
action_schema.description: Clean a carried object with a receptacle.

action_schema.name: heat
action_schema.description: Heat a carried object with a receptacle.

action_schema.name: cool
action_schema.description: Cool a carried object with a receptacle.
